verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents tracking all compliance requirements and deadlines. It provides a per-state dashboard that surfaces upcoming deadlines and files annual and franchise tax reports, with registered agent service in all 50 states. However, the evidence shows deadlines being displayed and handled, not proactive alerts or notifications sent ahead of each deadline. Missing for 10: documented advance alerts or notifications (email, push, or lead time) for annual report and franchise tax deadlines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of deadline tracking across multiple states.

support.subject: As a founder, I get alerts ahead of each state's annual report and franchise tax deadlines for every state where the provider is my agent

citations.quote: Get an instant overview of your company's status in each state. Click on a state to view requirements, upcoming deadlines, and take any necessary actions.
We track all compliance requirements and deadlines... we'll file all annual reports and franchise tax reports on your behalf!
Registered Agent available in all 50 states
